description: This file contains localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin in Turkish (tr). It provides messages for various UI elements and states such as errors, loading, and selection limits, specific to the Turkish language.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message shown when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters should be removed when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters need to be added when input is below the minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while a search is in progress.
